description: The Water Action Hub is a global online platform that maps hundreds of water sustainability and climate resilience projects and the organisations running them, so companies and others can find partners for collective action. The CEO Water Mandate of the UN Global Compact developed it. Users filter projects by country, region, project type, SDG targets, status and organisation type, search 100 priority basins, and browse communities such as nature-based solutions, replenishment and water funds; organisations can add their own projects and lessons learned, and basin initiatives such as the Mississippi, Godavari, Krishna and Cauvery and Rio Bravo are featured. Coverage is global. Format and access: a public website with a global map and project pages; adding content needs an account. Licence: the site's terms of use, no open licence stated; free. Caveats: projects are self-reported by participating organisations and are not verified or evenly spread. It helps locate nature-based water infrastructure projects for adaptation planning. Related catalogue records are the LIFE project database and the Landscape Performance Series case study briefs.
